glyph_origin: In oracle bone inscriptions, ideogrammic compound (會意): 吅 (“loudly”) + person with long hair (Similar to 老 without the cane) – "cry; weep". The pictogram of the person with long hair corrupted into 犬. Evidence suggests 吅 could be an abbreviation of the sound component 咢, making the character phono-semantic (形聲). Shuowen Jiezi interprets it as a phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 吅 (“to speak loudly”) + abbreviated phonetic 獄.
shuowen: Shuowen Jiezi interprets it as a phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 吅 (“to speak loudly”) + abbreviated phonetic 獄.
senses: [kū] to weep; to cry; to wail
